description: Read messages from a MAX chat. Use either chat_id OR message_ids — they are mutually exclusive. With chat_id: returns recent messages from that chat (use count/from/to to filter). With message_ids: returns those specific messages only (do NOT provide chat_id).

chat_id.description: The chat_id to read messages from. Omit when using message_ids.

count.description: Number of messages to return (1-100, default: 20). Only used with chat_id.

from.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds (Unix ms) for time range filter. Only used with chat_id.

message_ids.description: List of specific message IDs to retrieve. Do NOT provide chat_id when using this.

to.description: End timestamp in milliseconds (Unix ms) for time range filter. Only used with chat_id.

name: get_messages
title: Get Messages
